tool_input.description: Recreate varchar masking policy with CURRENT_ROLE check
tool_input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE MASKING POLICY KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.GOLD.mask_pii_varchar
  AS (val VARCHAR) RETURNS VARCHAR ->
  CASE
    WHEN CURRENT_ROLE() IN ('RIA_FULL_ACCESS', 'ACCOUNTADMIN') THEN val
    ELSE '***MASKED***'
  END
